messages:
Eva: Heads up — new intake candidate 'moss-lite-v2-7b-qdq'. Requesting prioritization for quant bring-up + quality gate runs. Targets: latency p50 <120ms, embedding PCC drop <= 0.02 vs baseline. Can we triage?

Tariq: Adding to the queue. Which prompt suites should we run first? quick smoke or full suite?

Alex: Start with core-smoke, convo-regression, and embeddings-compat. I can kick off the harness run now. ETA ~2h.

Eva: Run fp16 and int8-qdq weight-only configs. Use seed=42. Also include a small few-shot instruction-following set (10 examples) to catch alignment regressions.

Maria: Quick note — dedicated GPU shapes change latency. Tag perf runs with 'dedicated' vs 'hosted' so we can separate.

Alex: Kickoff command I used: `./eval_harness/run.py --model moss-lite-v2-7b-qdq --configs fp16,int8-qdq --suites core-smoke,convo-regression,embeddings-compat --seed 42 --tag dedicated,hosted`

deploy-bot: CI: eval job 5832 queued. Link: https://ci.redwood/internal/5832

Tariq: Gate thresholds proposal: embeddings PCC drop > 0.03 => FAIL. For NLG/regression: BLEU drop > 2 OR ROUGE-L drop > 1.5 => flag for review. Instruction-following accuracy drop > 2% => FAIL.

Alex: Acknowledged. Will attach raw outputs + short summary. If int8 is within quality bounds and latency improves >1.3x, mark candidate for canary.

Maria: Prioritization rules reminder: P1 if customer-impacting or regression on core prompts; otherwise P2/P3. Who will own the canary plan?

Eva: I'll own the initial canary and rollback policy. Plan: run evals by EOD, present summary in tomorrow's eng-ml standup.

Alex: Update: eval finished. Short summary: fp16 mostly parity; small instruction-following regression on chit-chat subset (-1.8%). int8-qdq embedding PCC delta = -0.012 (passes). Latency: int8 p50 = 85ms vs baseline 140ms. Uploading artifacts now.

Alex: Artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/moss-lite-v2-7b-qdq/5832/ , logs: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abcdef

Maria: Repro note — include tokenizer version and venv hash in the artifact metadata. If the instruction regression persists on the few-shot set, escalate to research for prompt calibration.

Eva: :thumbsup: Good. Moving to canary with automatic fallback to fp16 and a strict hallucination monitor.

Tariq: Canary checklist to include in rollout PR: 1) 1% traffic start, 2) auto rollback on quality alert, 3) cost delta monitor, 4) latency SLO alerts, 5) per-route trace sampling. I'll open the PR.

Alex: Done — PR #1248 created: https://git.redwood/pr/1248 (contains rollout config, metric thresholds, and dashboard links).

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 2024-10-18 14:00 UTC. Status: pending health checks.

Eva: Thanks team — will monitor first 30 minutes and report any anomalies in this thread.

Alex: Quick follow-up: small note in logs about softmax-numerics warnings on int8 path; I'll include a short follow-up patch if needed.

Maria: Adding reminder: add reflex tests to the smoke suite before widening traffic.

Tariq: All set from my side. Closing intake ticket once canary is healthy.
